description: This Java class 'NetworkChangeRequest' represents a request to change network parameters in a mock Zigbee core environment. It extends a base 'Request' class and, upon execution, sends a response and triggers a network change via 'MockZigbeeCore'.

classes.name: NetworkChangeRequest
classes.description: A request class that initiates a network change by specifying channel, panId, and networkKey, and executing the change in the mock Zigbee environment.

methods.name: NetworkChangeRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a network change request with request ID, channel, panId, and networkKey.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the network change request by sending a response and calling the networkChange method on the mock Zigbee core.
